description: An HTML file demonstrating usage of TinyMCE editor with custom templates, scripts, and integrations including external JavaScript files and inline JavaScript functions for document manipulation.

methods.name: exampleTemplateFunction
methods.description: Prompts the user for their favorite color and inserts it into the specified element.

methods.name: Invoice.calculate
methods.description: Calculates the total of invoice line items in a table and updates the DOM with the totals.

methods.name: WordCount.getText
methods.description: Retrieves the combined text content from the TinyMCE editor instance.

methods.name: WordCount.count
methods.description: Counts the number of words in the editor content and updates the DOM element.

methods.name: WordCount.charCount
methods.description: Counts the number of characters in the editor content and updates the DOM element.
